<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/sync/v2/session/refresh"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns a fresh device session when the current one ends within 60 days, and ends the old one five minutes later. Asking again with the old token in that time returns the same new token. Otherwise returns null and the client keeps its token.
